recording_operator: AI agent executing Playwright; no human participants
recording_source: Real Chromium viewport of local file-note-copilot; scripted model backend and seeded synthetic meeting content

label_policy.author: AI-authored task references, checked against operation logs and recorded frames; not human/expert gold
label_policy.time_windows: All intervals where the requested visual state is readable in the viewport, including later recurrences; never reduce long states to a point or one sampled frame
label_policy.sampling: DOM predicates sampled at 100 ms; visible means at least half the target area remains after viewport and scroll-container clipping
label_policy.verification: Review transition-adjacent frames and interior frames before running OCR/CLIP; record corrections with reasons. Never derive labels from OCR, CLIP, retrieval hits, or generated captions
label_policy.negative_policy: No acceptable intervals if the requested feature never appears anywhere in the recording

metrics.primary: Existing evaluator Recall@1/3/5 at IoU >= 0.3, top-1 IoU, negative false-positive rate; do not change existing retrieval code or thresholds
metrics.secondary: Evidence-time hit@1/3/5: any returned evidence timestamp falls inside any full acceptable interval. This point-localization diagnostic is distinct from clip-boundary quality
metrics.boundary: For answerable queries with a top hit, report nearest reference interval start/end absolute errors (minimum combined error), including misses; no-hit is missing, not zero error
metrics.aggregation: Report each recording and pooled counts. Both recordings share one source group, so no independent-video confidence interval or generalization claim
metrics.decision: Descriptive pilot only. Any screen-only lift versus an empty speech baseline is expected by construction. Report false positives and indexing time with recall; no user time-savings or general fusion superiority claim

tasks.workflow: Paste synthetic transcript, choose verified workflow, draft, inspect unsupported decision, edit it, save and approve

queries.query: Show the pasted meeting transcript before drafting the note.
Where is the unsupported decision flagged for review?
Find the claim text editor while the unsupported decision is being corrected.
Show the approved note and its changed lines.

tasks.workflow: Choose verified workflow, draft from a different synthetic transcript, follow an evidence chip, mark needs-work feedback, type a comment and submit feedback

queries.query: Where is the extract compose verify repair strategy selected?
Show the highlighted transcript segment after following an evidence reference.
Where is the needs work feedback comment being entered?
Show the credit card payment checkout.

retention: Publish only viewport recordings, synthetic content, event logs, labels and measured reports. No private desktop, credentials, actual client data or existing database
deviations: Record any execution or annotation deviation before inspecting model predictions. Do not tune queries, thresholds, or recordings to improve retrieval scores
